title: BRAIN AND BEHAVIOR
description: Provides an in-depth analysis of a variety of topics related to human brain structure and function introduced in lower-division coursework. Integrates neuroanatomy, neurochemistry, and psychological research with respect to both typical and atypical human behavior. Emphasizes critical evaluation of empirical research and theoretical models beyond the introductory level.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (PSY 201, 201H, 201Z or 201HZ) and (PSY 202, 202H, 202Z or 202HZ).
A minimum grade of C- is required in PSY 201, PSY 201H, PSY 201Z, PSY 201HZ, PSY 202, PSY 202H, PSY 202Z and PSY 202HZ.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
